The total proportion of people who texted while driving everyday and have never worn helmets is `r proportion`

## Inference on proportions 

```{r}
#| title: iop


data('yrbss', package='openintro')
no_helmet <- yrbss %>%
  filter(helmet_12m == "never")

no_helmet <- no_helmet %>%
  mutate(text_ind = ifelse(text_while_driving_30d == "30", "yes", "no"))

boot_dist <- no_helmet %>%
  filter(!is.na(text_ind)) %>%
  specify(response = text_ind, success = "yes") %>%
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "bootstrap") %>%
  calculate(stat = "prop") %>%
  get_ci(level = 0.95)
```

## Exercise 3 

```{r}
#| title: error-rate

boot_dist <- no_helmet |>
  filter(!is.na(text_ind)) |>
  specify(response = text_ind, success = "yes") |>
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "bootstrap") |>
  calculate(stat = "prop")

ci <- boot_dist |>
  get_ci(level = 0.95, type = "percentile")
ci

margin <- (ci$upper_ci - ci$lower_ci) / 2
```

The margin for error is `r margin`

## Proportion and margin for error

```{r}
#| title: p&me

n <- 1000

p <- seq(from = 0, to = 1, by = 0.01)
me <- 2 * sqrt(p * (1 - p)/n)

dd <- data.frame(p = p, me = me)
ggplot(data = dd, aes(x = p, y = me)) + 
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Population Proportion", y = "Margin of Error")

.1 + 2*(sqrt(0.1 * 0.9 / 300))
```

The relationship between p and me based on the graph is a symmetric upside down arch centered at .5

## Exercise 9 

```{r}
#| title: training-model

yrbss_sleep <- yrbss |>
  filter(!is.na(school_night_hours_sleep), !is.na(strength_training_7d)) |>
  mutate(sleep_10 = ifelse(school_night_hours_sleep == "10+", "10+", "less"),
         st_daily = ifelse(strength_training_7d == 7, "yes", "no"))

obs_diff <- yrbss_sleep |>
  specify(st_daily ~ sleep_10, success = "yes") |>
  calculate(stat = "diff in props", order = c("10+", "less"))

null_dist <- yrbss_sleep |>
  specify(st_daily ~ sleep_10, success = "yes") |>
  hypothesize(null = "independence") |>
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "permute") |>
  calculate(stat = "diff in props", order = c("10+", "less"))

get_p_value(null_dist, obs_stat = obs_diff, direction = "greater")


yrbss_sleep |>
  specify(st_daily ~ sleep_10, success = "yes") |>
  generate(reps = 1000, type = "bootstrap") |>
  calculate(stat = "diff in props", order = c("10+", "less")) |>
  get_ci(level = 0.95)

(1.95/.01)^2 * .25
```

according to the results we can determine that those that sleep more than 10 hours a night are more likely to strength train every day
